Name: (AT) Alpaca Facelift
Author: emjess
Description:
I love having omena007’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]Alpacas[/url] in my game, but I wanted them to match siamance's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]. Siamance has very generous open permissions, so I cobbled these facelifted alpacas together based on their sheep sprites!

This is my first mod, probably not perfect (do they look more like llamas than alpacas??)

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]Alpacas[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].

[s]Now available for Content Patcher! [/s]False alarm, gotta figure some things out first. ---> CP version here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46717]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46717[/url]
